usageNotes: Instructs the QEMU Guest Agent inside the VM to freeze all filesystems (fsfreeze), quiescing writes so a consistent snapshot or backup can be taken. The VM must be running with the Guest Agent installed, enabled, and responsive — the call will fail otherwise. Always follow with a thaw (fsfreeze-thaw) as soon as the snapshot is complete, since frozen filesystems block all guest writes and will cause application timeouts.

examples.summary: Freeze filesystems on VM 101 before taking a snapshot on node pve01

tips: Pair with post_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_agent_fsfreeze_thaw immediately after the snapshot is captured — leaving filesystems frozen will hang guest I/O.
Check guest agent status first via get_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_agent_info to confirm the agent is running before issuing the freeze.
Requires the VM.GuestAgent.FileSystemMgmt (or Unrestricted) privilege on /vms/{vmid} — standard VM.PowerMgmt alone is not sufficient.
The returned result object reflects the Guest Agent's response; a non-error result does not guarantee all filesystems were frozen if the guest OS has uncooperative mounts.
